name: Clean Slate
source:
World-famous geneticist Dr. Lucien Janus has gone missing inside his own lab. It is up to Brendan Alaster, retired detective and old friend to Janus, to carry out a clandestine investigation and find out the truth in just one night. Inside, Brendan will find two other people who have also heard about the Doctor's disappearance and are interested in finding him - but can they be trusted?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1568920/]Steam[/url]]
